summary: Master competency-based recruitment and selection. Learn structured interviewing, BARS, and ISO 30405 standards to improve quality of hire. Enroll today.
lede: Competency-based interviewing uses role requirements and observable behaviours to assess candidates consistently. For talent acquisition specialists, HR business partners and hiring managers, this training supports defining vacancy criteria and evaluating candidate evidence. It covers KSAO-based profiling, structured interview questions, evidence-based scoring with calibrated rating rubrics, and documenting selection decisions.
audienceIntro: Competency-based recruitment training is designed for professionals who define vacancies, assess candidate evidence, manage selection panels, or govern hiring quality. It suits intermediate practitioners who already work with recruitment activity and want a more structured assessment process.
prerequisites: Working experience in recruitment, talent acquisition, human resources, workforce planning, or hiring management is recommended. You should be comfortable reviewing job descriptions, interviewing candidates, and working with basic recruitment metrics. No programming is required. The course uses recruitment scenarios and templates, so bring a laptop if you want to adapt the materials to your own vacancy examples. Advanced AI and analytics topics remain at an operational application level rather than technical engineering depth.
